speaker: PEACOCK - PLAYFUL VOICE

speaker: CAMEL - PLAYFUL VOICE

speaker: ELEPHANT - PLAYFUL VOICE

english: Hey, lad! Here comes the pride of the fair!

english: Make way! The parade of colours has arrived!

speaker: FESTIVAL CALLER
hindi: नाच बाद में, पहले रास्ता दे!
english: Dance later! Clear the way first!
